sources.title: Le Coquillage — MICHELIN Guide
sources.claim: Le Coquillage is a Michelin-starred restaurant at Château Richeux in Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes, run by Hugo Roellinger.

sources.title: Saint-Malo → Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes (ViaMichelin)
sources.claim: Saint-Malo is 8.7 km / ~10 min by road from Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes.

sources.title: Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes → Dinan (ViaMichelin)
sources.claim: Dinan is 30.8 km / ~29 min by road — just outside a strict 30 km radius.

sources.title: CPS-IoT Week 2026
sources.claim: CPS-IoT Week 2026 — 19th edition — takes place 11–14 May 2026 in Saint-Malo.

sources.title: CPS-IoT Week 2026 — venue
sources.claim: Held at the Palais des Congrès de Saint-Malo (Palais du Grand Large), 1 Quai Duguay-Trouin.

sources.title: CPS-IoT Week 2026 — events
sources.claim: Bundles HSCC/ICCPS, SenSys, RTAS plus seven workshops (ENSsys, DESTION, CAADCPS, RAGE, FMSys, TADAM, FACCT).

sources.title: RTAS 2026
sources.claim: RTAS 2026 — 32nd IEEE Real-Time and Embedded Technology and Applications Symposium — runs 12–14 May 2026.

sources.title: HSCC/ICCPS 2026
sources.claim: 29th ACM HSCC + 17th ACM/IEEE ICCPS, 11–14 May 2026, with an AI-enabled Autonomy track in 2026.

sources.title: SenSys 2026
sources.claim: ACM/IEEE Embedded Artificial Intelligence and Sensing Systems — unified successor to SenSys, IPSN and IoTDI.

sources.title: PQCrypto 2026
sources.claim: 17th International Conference on Post-Quantum Cryptography — 14–16 April 2026 in Saint-Malo (IRISA / INRIA / IRMAR).

sources.title: PQCrypto 2026 proceedings (Springer LNCS 16491/16492)
sources.claim: 27 full papers from 66 submissions, published as LNCS 16491/16492.

sources.title: Rencontres Stratégiques des Trois Océans — 7jours.fr
sources.claim: Inaugural event on European digital sovereignty for ~100 defence/tech decision-makers, 9–10 April 2026.

sources.title: Digital Benchmark Saint-Malo 2026
sources.claim: L'entreprise 2030: Agentique, Souveraine, Décarbonée — 28–29 September 2026, ~300 CMOs/CDOs, 25 keynotes, 30 workshops.

sources.title: Forum des Métiers du Numérique — IUT Saint-Malo
sources.claim: Free career fair (cybersecurity, cloud, network) — Saturday 21 March 2026 at IUT Saint-Malo, 40 Rue de la Croix Désilles.

sources.title: Flag'Malo CTF
sources.claim: Annual CTF organised by IUT Saint-Malo's Réseaux & Télécoms students — advertised as the largest CTF in Brittany.

sources.title: Le Poool — La French Tech Rennes-St-Malo
sources.claim: Innovation hub spanning Rennes and Saint-Malo, running Digital Tech Conference, Matinales, Market Pitch, Startup on the Beach and incubation programs.

sources.title: Le Poool Saint-Malo — Saint-Malo Agglomération
sources.claim: Le Poool's Saint-Malo coworking site sits near the station / Grande Passerelle, supported by Saint-Malo Agglomération.
